note: The English catalogue at /en/credit-card is a Next.js page. The default Personal tab shows 18 visible tiles (generic and digital cards) marked div.credit-card-item. The same page payload also lists co-branded, affinity and invitation-only consumer cards (81 consumer cards in total, excluding 3 corporate cards). Invitation and Corporate are tabs on this page; View More Cards reveals further generic products such as Cash Back, Senior and I AM. The fetcher may class the page captcha because of a reCAPTCHA legal notice on the apply form; the public card list is present. Product pages under /en/ktc-digitalcard/ are on the same official host. The site has an English version, so this recipe starts from the English catalogue only.
